result.title: Document launch, store and account operations
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Write an operator and member guide based on the built candidate, including local pairing, the supported 0.3/0.3 pair, fresh-store creation, older-store refusal, invite, recovery, profile edits, session policies, retained Home handling and rollback.

**Verify** · Follow the Windows instructions from a cold start using disposable stores. Match behaviour to the selected version and redact all credentials.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-075

**Queue** · Follows WI-075 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
